en: Puhuhu! Surprised? What a twist, huh?

E-Even I didn't see that coming!
All my little cubs have been destroyed!

Waaaaah! So sad! All that cuteness gone
to waste!

What are you talking about!?
You're the one responsible for this!

Wh-Why would you do such a thing to
your own children!?

Cuz lately they've been acting all
buddy-buddy and neglecting me.

Gah! I'm never gonna get the hang of this
whole "parenting" thing!
Th-That's...why?

Doesn't matter now.
We don't have the time to give him attention.

Anyway, I'm gonna walk away quietly and
go mourn my dead kids! Later!

Waaaaaaaaaaaah!
Gooontaaa!

Dammit!
Why did it turn out like this!?

Hey, Kokichi...why don't you tell us now?
What is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

If we don't know it, then we won't be
able to understand or accept it.

I...can't accept it either, Kokichi!
What is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?

What kind of secret would
push Gonta that far!?

Kokichi, if you really cared for Gonta,
explain yourself to everyone and-
I don't...want to...
You what?
I don't want to, stupidhead!
Kokichi!?

Ah-hahahaha! Oh man, did you fall for all
that fake crying!?

You're so dumb!
I would never cry for Gonta!
F-Fake...crying?

If I said the <CLT=cltSTRONG>actual truth<CLT=cltNORMAL> back there,
Gonta would've been reeeeal mad!

That would've interfered with the game,
so I simply lied to calm him down.

...See? 
As long as you lie for a good purpose, right?
What!?

What do you mean, <CLT=cltSTRONG>what really happened<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Why did you make him do that!?
Obviously, so it wouldn't be boring!
What are you...?

I gave Gonta an incentive, cuz I thought
it'd liven up the game.
C'mon, think about it.

If I actually wanted to <CLT=cltSTRONG>save everyone<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
like what Gonta did...

I wouldn't have betrayed Gonta.
You should've realized that.
Th-Then...why did Gonta—
Nee-heehee...nee-heeheeheehee...
Who cares about that idiot!?

I wanna enjoy this game filled with suspicion
and betrayal from the bottom of my heart!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi gave us one of
his creepy smiles.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I saw it, I finally saw Kokichi
for what he really is.
<CLT=cltMIND>Malice.

<CLT=cltMIND>His entire body, nothing
but raw and unfettered malice.

I *am* the supreme leader of evil, so it's
obvious my personality would be twisted.
The more you suffer, the more I enjoy it.

There are people in this world who spread grief
and misery for no reason than the thrill of it!

And I'm one of those people. Nothing pleases me
more than inflicting pain on others!

S-Seriously...
Who the hell do you think you are?

So...for your own entertainment,
you sacrificed Miu and Gonta?

What's so bad about that? 
You kill people for money...right, Maki Roll?

Someone like you has no right to call
me Maki Roll...
...Do you want to die?

Nee-heehee...you look so much better with
a scowl on your face, Maki Roll.

But hey, you guys are just waaay too trusting.
If only you had suspected me more, then...

...Ah-hahahaha! Miu and Gonta wouldn't
have died such meaningless deaths!
M-Meaningless deaths!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito screamed and
sprinted up to Kokichi like a bullet...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>WHAM!

<CLT=cltMIND>A dull thud resounded
through our skulls.

Oops, sorry! I tried to dodge you...but
I punched you instead.
Kaito!
Y-You...!
By the way, Kaito, is it just me...?
Or are you waaay slower?
Ah...

Maybe, just maybe...Kaito is hiding something
from us, too.
Kaito! Are you okay!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito kept coming at him,
and Maki glared at Kokichi with piercing eyes.

For someone who claims to be bad at fighting,
you were pretty agile just now.
Ah-haha! And you believed a lie like that!?
You...really want to die, don't you!?

Oh, did I finally provoke you enough?
Is it cuz of Kaito?
No, Maki!

What am I thinking? Maki wouldn't lose
her cool for a guy like Kaito.

He's waaaay too pathetic.
He's all bark and no bite.

Let's face it. The Ultimate Astronaut 
is just a trainee anywa—

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi never got to finish
his provocation.

<CLT=cltMIND>No one cared what he had to say
anymore. They all rushed to Kaito's side.
Kaito, are you hurt!?

Can you stand? Do you need to lean
on my shoulder?

S-Sorry! My MP's at zero, so I can't 
use any recovery magic!

Hey...why are you all so worried 
about this pathetic gu—
Pathetic? Look at yourself, Kokichi.
...What?

Kaito always has us by his side, see?
But no one wants to be around you.

You're alone, Kokichi.
And you always will be.

Ah-haha! You're talking about friends?
Friends don't make this game more entert—

Geez, boooring.
I'm no longer interested.

I don't care anymore...
But, I will tell you this...

The one who will win this game
...is me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi spat out those words,
then left the room.
Guh... Haaah...
Kaito, are you okay?
Grh... Uuugh...
Hey, Kaito...?

You don't look well... It didn't seem like
he punched you that hard, but...
Did you hit your head or something?
I-I'm okay... It's fine...

Don't push yourself.
You should lie down and-
I s-said I'm...fine...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito tried to get up, but...
Urgh!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito doubled over, his
knees gave out, and he collapsed hard...
*cough*
*cough, cough*
Wh-What?
K-Kaito!?

Blood!? Why!?
What's the matter, Kaito!?
C'mon... Don't freak out over this...

It's nothing...
My...cold just got worse is all...

I didn't know that coughing up blood was
a cold symptom!

You're a robot and you don't know that?
I'm saying it's fine... Just chill...

I just...coughed too much and cut my
throat or something... I dunno...

<CLT=cltMIND>As he spoke, he somehow
got to his feet...

Y-Yeah, that's it...
I just need a drink of water...

Sorry, but...
I'm...gonna head back to my room...
Okay, I'll go with—
Don't follow me!!!
...What?

I can walk on my own.
I don't need your help...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Shuichi<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito staggered off.

...I'll go with him.
It would be bad if he collapses on the way.
Right... We'll leave it to you then.

D-Don't worry about it, Shuichi.
Kaito was just...stressed out, is all.
<CLT=cltMIND>Why...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Why...did it end up like this?

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought... I thought I could help...
I wanted us all to survive...

<CLT=cltMIND>And I wanted it so damn bad, I kept
fighting for it, fighting for the truth...
<CLT=cltMIND>And this is what I get!?

<CLT=cltMIND>By trying to survive, we're
just playing the stupid game...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Just like Kokichi.
...Damn it!
It's almost time...

Yeah, it's almost time.
This should be enough...
I'll end it.
Now is the time...
...I'll end this killing game.
